outcome: changes in deep scar fold structure (ultrasound)
changes in superficial scar fold structure (scar fold measurement)
cohort: 10 healthy individuals with post C-section scars that were more than one and a half years old and without associated pathologies affecting healing.
finding: The application of eight weekly Myofascial Induction Therapy (MIT) sessions resulted in observable changes in the deep and superficial structure of post C-section scar folds, alongside functional improvement and measured patient quality of life.
mod_finding: The study specifically investigated the effects of Myofascial Induction Therapy on scars resulting from C-section births.
followup_time: More than 1.5 years after birth (age of scars at study entry)
